gate: Full-size P3 legacy SQLite conversion admission, fault transport, unchanged source rows, and exact managed restart
limitations: The P3 source is a deterministic packed-weight capacity fixture; it does not establish evolved real-time P3 performance.
This exercises supported legacy conversion into a new managed generation-one run, not a P3 configuration on the --fresh CLI.
RSS includes allocations retained across fixture creation and all startup attempts in one process. It does not close an isolated production memory gate.
An initial run has one current pointer and no explicit active selection row. Normal restart must resolve the sole current run and its exact checkpoint.
cleanup: Required report and executed runner retained in the project; owned remote checkout, addon, database and managed files removed after stopped-process and exact-path checks. Owner service remains stopped.
